## Summary
Describe the change and the problem it solves.

## Type of change
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Security fix (coordinate privately first; do not disclose vulnerability details here)
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Other

## Validation
- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] Relevant CI checks pass
- [ ] Windows checked, if relevant
- [ ] Linux checked, if relevant
- [ ] macOS checked, if relevant

## Security, privacy and platform compliance
- [ ] No credentials, tokens, personal data or confidential platform information included
- [ ] No undocumented or unauthorized platform access
- [ ] No DRM, authentication, anti-cheat or access-control bypass
- [ ] No unintended modification of user game files or launcher metadata
- [ ] Security and privacy implications have been considered

## Reviewer notes
List risks, limitations, migration concerns or additional manual checks.
